test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Bite the bullet

options.text: To get something over with because it is inevitable
To eat something unhealthy because of its taste
To buy ammunition because of upcoming danger
To feel powerless because of fatigue

solution:
The correct answer is: **To get something over with because it is inevitable **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• "**Bite the bullet**" means to face a difficult or unpleasant situation with courage and determination. (किसी कठिन या अप्रिय स्थिति का साहस और दृढ़ संकल्प के साथ सामना करना)

 
 
• **For example**: *The kids decided to bite the bullet and clean their rooms so they could go to the park.*
 
 
 
• The phrase originated from the practice of having soldiers bite on a bullet during surgery to endure the pain without making noise.
 
• The idiom is often used in situations where one has to endure something unpleasant, like a tough decision or a painful experience.
 
• The phrase is commonly used in informal and formal contexts and is recognized as a part of English idiomatic expressions.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**
